item.title: Continuing power outages force Friday delays at four Rapid City Area schools
item.description: RAPID CITY, S.D. — Rapid City Area Schools says they're going to have to delay the start of classes at four schools on Friday. District officials say those schools are still without power in the wake of the windstorm Wednesday night into Thursday.
